holdout: Secondary fixed-suite endpoint, frozen after wave 2 and before seeing wave 3 output; never exposed to Plan
estimator: Outcome = percent reduction of mean route distance vs paired NN. Memory = ((B-A)+(D-C))/2; Math = ((C-A)+(D-B))/2; interaction = D-C-B+A. Average the 3 blocks equally.
uncertainty: Report all 3 block contrasts and their range; no formal significance claim from 3 paired seeds.
alignment_scope: Manual code evidence tags; broad direct exploration usually unknown. A valid aligned incumbent improvement gives scoped hypothesis support; other results need separate evaluation of adoption and validity.
